trap.label: 1º × 2º condicional
trap.wrong: If she would find a cook, she would teach him. (real)
trap.right: If she finds a cook, she will teach him.
trap.why: Em português o futuro do subjuntivo (“se ela achar”) é diferente do imperfeito (“se achasse”). Em inglês, real = if + presente, will; irreal = if + passado, would.

mcq.q: If she ___ a cook, she will teach him.
If I ___ rich, I would travel.

fix.wrong: If it rains, we would stay.
fix.right: If it rains, we will stay.

fix.wrong: If I had money, I will buy it.
fix.right: If I had money, I would buy it.

fix.wrong: If she will come, we start.
fix.right: If she comes, we will start.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 1º condicional: “If I had time, I would help.”
rewrite.answer: If I have time, I will help.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 2º condicional: “If it rains, we will stay.”
rewrite.answer: If it rained, we would stay.

rewrite.prompt: Complete: “If he (study) harder, he would pass.”
rewrite.answer: If he studied harder, he would pass.
